verses.original: וְאַתָּ֤ה בֶן־ אָדָם֙ הִנָּבֵ֣א עַל־ גּ֔וֹג וְאָ֣מַרְתָּ֔ כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה הִנְנִ֤י אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ גּ֔וֹג נְשִׂ֕יא רֹ֖אשׁ מֶ֥שֶׁךְ וְתֻבָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ḇen- ’ā·ḏām hin·nā·ḇê ‘al- gō·wḡ wə·’ā·mar·tā kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh hin·nî ’ê·le·ḵā gō·wḡ nə·śî rōš me·šeḵ wə·ṯu·ḇāl
verses.literal: As for you O son of man prophesy against Gog and declare that this is what the Lord GOD says Behold I am against you O Gog chief prince of Meshech and Tubal
verses.literalPt: Tu, filho do homem, profetiza contra Gogue e dize: Assim diz o Senhor Jeová: Eis que sou contra ti, ó Gogue, príncipe de Rôs, Meseque e Tubal;

verses.original: וְשֹׁבַבְתִּ֙יךָ֙ וְשִׁשֵּׁאתִ֔יךָ וְהַעֲלִיתִ֖יךָ מִיַּרְכְּתֵ֣י צָפ֑וֹן וַהֲבִאוֹתִ֖ךָ עַל־ הָרֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šō·ḇaḇ·tî·ḵā wə·šiš·šê·ṯî·ḵā wə·ha·‘ă·lî·ṯî·ḵā mî·yar·kə·ṯê ṣā·p̄ō·wn wa·hă·ḇi·’ō·w·ṯi·ḵā ‘al- hā·rê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: I will turn you around drive you along bring you up from the far north and send you against the mountains of Israel
verses.literalPt: far-te-ei virar, e te conduzirei, e te farei subir dos últimos confins do norte, e te trarei para subir os montes de Israel.

verses.original: וְהִכֵּיתִ֥י קַשְׁתְּךָ֖ מִיַּ֣ד שְׂמֹאולֶ֑ךָ וְחִצֶּ֕יךָ מִיַּ֥ד יְמִינְךָ֖ אַפִּֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hik·kê·ṯî qaš·tə·ḵā mî·yaḏ śə·mō·w·le·ḵā wə·ḥiṣ·ṣe·ḵā mî·yaḏ yə·mî·nə·ḵā ’ap·pîl
verses.literal: Then I will strike the bow from your left hand and dash down the arrows from your right hand
verses.literalPt: Com um golpe, tirarei da tua mão esquerda o teu arco e farei cair da tua mão direita as tuas flechas.

verses.original: עַל־ הָרֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל תִּפּ֗וֹל אַתָּה֙ וְכָל־ אֲגַפֶּ֔יךָ וְעַמִּ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתָּ֑ךְ לְעֵ֨יט צִפּ֧וֹר כָּל־ כָּנָ֛ף וְחַיַּ֥ת הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה נְתַתִּ֥יךָ לְאָכְלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- hā·rê yiś·rā·’êl tip·pō·wl ’at·tāh wə·ḵāl ’ă·ḡap·pe·ḵā wə·‘am·mîm ’ă·šer ’it·tāḵ lə·‘êṭ ṣip·pō·wr kāl- kā·nāp̄ wə·ḥay·yaṯ haś·śā·ḏeh nə·ṯat·tî·ḵā lə·’āḵ·lāh
verses.literal: On the mountains of Israel you will fall you and all your troops and the nations with you I will give you as food to every kind of ravenous bird and wild beast
verses.literalPt: Sobre os montes de Israel, cairás, tu, todas as tuas tropas e os povos que estão contigo; e te darei às aves de rapina de toda sorte e aos animais do campo, para que te devorem.

verses.original: עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה תִּפּ֑וֹל כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י דִבַּ֔רְתִּי נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- pə·nê haś·śā·ḏeh tip·pō·wl kî ’ă·nî ḏib·bar·tî nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: You will fall in the open field . . . for I have spoken declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: Sobre a face do campo, cairás, porque eu o falei, diz o Senhor Jeová.

verses.original: וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי־ אֵ֣שׁ בְּמָג֔וֹג וּבְיֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָאִיִּ֖ים לָבֶ֑טַח וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šil·laḥ·tî- ’êš bə·mā·ḡō·wḡ ū·ḇə·yō·šə·ḇê hā·’î·yîm lā·ḇe·ṭaḥ wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: I will send fire on Magog and on those who dwell securely in the coastlands and they will know that I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: Meterei o fogo em Magogue e nos que habitam seguros nas ilhas; e saberão que eu sou Jeová.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ שֵׁ֨ם קָדְשִׁ֜י אוֹדִ֗יעַ בְּתוֹךְ֙ עַמִּ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְלֹֽא־ אַחֵ֥ל אֶת־ שֵׁם־ קָדְשִׁ֖י ע֑וֹד וְיָדְע֤וּ הַגּוֹיִם֙ כִּי־ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה קָד֖וֹשׁ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- šêm qāḏ·šî ’ō·w·ḏî·a‘ bə·ṯō·wḵ ‘am·mî yiś·rā·’êl wə·lō- ’a·ḥêl ’eṯ- šêm- qāḏ·šî ‘ō·wḏ wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū hag·gō·w·yim kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh qā·ḏō·wōš bə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: So I will make My holy name known among My people Israel and will no longer allow it . . . to be profaned Then the nations will know that I am the LORD the Holy One in Israel
verses.literalPt: Farei conhecido o meu nome no meio do meu povo de Israel e nunca mais deixarei profanar o meu santo nome; as nações saberão que eu sou Jeová, o Santo de Israel.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה בָאָה֙ וְנִֽהְיָ֔תָה נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה ה֥וּא הַיּ֖וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּֽרְתִּי׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ḇā·’āh wə·nih·yā·ṯāh nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh hū hay·yō·wm ’ă·šer dib·bar·tî
verses.literal: Yes it is coming and it will surely happen declares the Lord GOD This is the day of which I have spoken
verses.literalPt: Eis que isso vem e se realizará, diz o Senhor Jeová; este é o dia de que falei.

verses.original: וְֽיָצְא֞וּ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י׀ עָרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וּבִעֲר֡וּ וְ֠הִשִּׂיקוּ בְּנֶ֨שֶׁק וּמָגֵ֤ן וְצִנָּה֙ בְּקֶ֣שֶׁת וּבְחִצִּ֔ים וּבְמַקֵּ֥ל יָ֖ד וּבְרֹ֑מַח וּבִעֲר֥וּ בָהֶ֛ם אֵ֖שׁ שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·ṣə·’ū yō·šə·ḇê ‘ā·rê yiś·rā·’êl ū·ḇi·‘ă·rū wə·hiś·śî·qū bə·ne·šeq ū·mā·ḡên wə·ṣin·nāh bə·qe·šeṯ ū·ḇə·ḥiṣ·ṣîm ū·ḇə·maq·qêl yāḏ ū·ḇə·rō·maḥ ū·ḇi·‘ă·rū ḇā·hem ’êš še·ḇa‘ šā·nîm
verses.literal: Then those who dwell in the cities of Israel will go out kindle fires and burn up the weapons the bucklers and shields the bows and arrows the clubs . . . and spears For seven years they will use them for fuel
verses.literalPt: Os habitantes das cidades de Israel sairão e, com as armas, acenderão fogo, queimando os escudos e os paveses, os arcos e as flechas, os bastões de mão e as lanças; com elas, acenderão fogo por sete anos,

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ יִשְׂא֨וּ עֵצִ֜ים מִן־ הַשָּׂדֶ֗ה וְלֹ֤א יַחְטְבוּ֙ מִן־ הַיְּעָרִ֔ים כִּ֥י בַנֶּ֖שֶׁק יְבַֽעֲרוּ־ אֵ֑שׁ וְשָׁלְל֣וּ אֶת־ שֹׁלְלֵיהֶ֗ם וּבָֽזְזוּ֙ אֶת־ בֹּ֣זְזֵיהֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- yiś·’ū ‘ê·ṣîm min- haś·śā·ḏeh wə·lō yaḥ·ṭə·ḇū min- hay·yə·‘ā·rîm kî ḇan·ne·šeq yə·ḇa·‘ă·rū- ’êš wə·šā·lə·lū ’eṯ- šō·lə·lê·hem ū·ḇā·zə·zū ’eṯ- bō·zə·zê·hem nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: They will not gather wood from the countryside . . . or cut it from the forests for they will use the weapons for fuel . . . They will loot those who looted them and plunder those who plundered them declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: de sorte que não trarão lenha do campo, nem a cortarão dos bosques. Pois com as armas acenderão fogo, despojarão os que despojaram e roubarão os que os roubaram, diz o Senhor Jeová.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה בַיּ֣וֹם הַה֡וּא אֶתֵּ֣ן לְגוֹג֩׀ מְקֽוֹם־ שָׁ֨ם קֶ֜בֶר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל גֵּ֤י הָעֹֽבְרִים֙ קִדְמַ֣ת הַיָּ֔ם וְחֹסֶ֥מֶת הִ֖יא אֶת־ הָעֹֽבְרִ֑ים וְקָ֣בְרוּ שָׁ֗ם אֶת־ גּוֹג֙ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ הֲמוֹנֹ֔ה וְקָ֣רְא֔וּ גֵּ֖יא הֲמ֥וֹן גּֽוֹג׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ḇay·yō·wm ha·hū ’et·tên lə·ḡō·wḡ mə·qō·wm- šām qe·ḇer bə·yiś·rā·’êl gê hā·‘ō·ḇə·rîm qiḏ·maṯ hay·yām wə·ḥō·se·meṯ hî ’eṯ- hā·‘ō·ḇə·rîm wə·qā·ḇə·rū šām ’eṯ- gō·wḡ wə·’eṯ- kāl- hă·mō·nōh wə·qā·rə·’ū gê hă·mō·wn gō·wḡ
verses.literal: And on that day I will give Gog a burial place in Israel the Valley of the Travelers east of the Sea It will block those who travel through because Gog and all his hordes will be buried there So it will be called . . . the Valley of Hamon-gog
verses.literalPt: Naquele dia, darei a Gogue como lugar de sepultura em Israel, o vale dos que passam, ao oriente do mar; fará parar aos que passam; ali, sepultarão a Gogue e toda a sua multidão e chamar-lhe-ão o vale de Hamom-Gogue.

verses.original: וּקְבָרוּם֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְמַ֖עַן טַהֵ֣ר אֶת־ הָאָ֑רֶץ שִׁבְעָ֖ה חֳדָשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·qə·ḇā·rūm bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl lə·ma·‘an ṭa·hêr ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ šiḇ·‘āh ḥo·ḏā·šîm
verses.literal: For seven months the house of Israel will be burying them in order to cleanse the land
verses.literalPt: Os da casa de Israel levarão sete meses em sepultá-los, para purificarem a terra.

verses.original: וְקָֽבְרוּ֙ כָּל־ עַ֣ם הָאָ֔רֶץ וְהָיָ֥ה לָהֶ֖ם לְשֵׁ֑ם י֚וֹם הִכָּ֣בְדִ֔י נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·qā·ḇə·rū kāl- ‘am hā·’ā·reṣ wə·hā·yāh lā·hem lə·šêm yō·wm hik·kā·ḇə·ḏî nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: All the people of the land will bury them and it will bring them renown on the day I display My glory declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: Todo o povo da terra os sepultará; isso lhes servirá de fama no dia em que eu for glorificado, diz o Senhor Jeová.

verses.original: וְאַנְשֵׁ֨י תָמִ֤יד יַבְדִּ֙ילוּ֙ עֹבְרִ֣ים בָּאָ֔רֶץ מְקַבְּרִ֣ים אֶת־ הָעֹבְרִ֗ים אֶת־ הַנּוֹתָרִ֛ים עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ לְטַֽהֲרָ֑הּ מִקְצֵ֥ה שִׁבְעָֽה־ חֳדָשִׁ֖ים יַחְקֹֽרוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’an·šê ṯā·mîḏ yaḇ·dî·lū ‘ō·ḇə·rîm bā·’ā·reṣ mə·qab·bə·rîm ’eṯ- hā·‘ō·ḇə·rîm ’eṯ- han·nō·w·ṯā·rîm ‘al- pə·nê hā·’ā·reṣ lə·ṭa·hă·rāh miq·ṣêh šiḇ·‘āh- ḥo·ḏā·šîm yaḥ·qō·rū
verses.literal: And men will be employed to continually pass through the land to cleanse it by burying the invaders who remain on the ground At the end of the seven months they will begin their search
verses.literalPt: Eles separarão homens que, para purificarem a terra, incessantemente a percorram, sepultando os que passam, a saber, os que ficam sobre a face da terra; depois de passados sete meses, farão essa busca.

verses.original: וְעָבְר֤וּ הָעֹֽבְרִים֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ וְרָאָה֙ עֶ֣צֶם אָדָ֔ם וּבָנָ֥ה אֶצְל֖וֹ צִיּ֑וּן עַ֣ד קָבְר֤וּ אֹתוֹ֙ הַֽמְקַבְּרִ֔ים אֶל־ גֵּ֖יא הֲמ֥וֹן גּֽוֹג׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·ḇə·rū hā·‘ō·ḇə·rîm bā·’ā·reṣ wə·rā·’āh ‘e·ṣem ’ā·ḏām ū·ḇā·nāh ’eṣ·lōw ṣî·yūn ‘aḏ qā·ḇə·rū ’ō·ṯōw ham·qab·bə·rîm ’el- gê hă·mō·wn gō·wḡ
verses.literal: As they pass . . . through the land anyone who sees a human bone will set up a pillar next to it until the gravediggers have buried it in . . . the Valley of Hamon-gog
verses.literalPt: Os que percorrem a terra a percorrerão, e, quando algum deles vir um osso de homem, pôr-lhe-á ao pé um sinal, até que os enterradores o tenham enterrado no vale de Hamom-Gogue.

verses.original: וְגַ֥ם שֶׁם־ עִ֛יר הֲמוֹנָ֖ה וְטִהֲר֥וּ הָאָֽרֶץ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam šem- ‘îr hă·mō·w·nāh wə·ṭi·hă·rū hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Even the city will be named Hamonah And so they will cleanse the land
verses.literalPt: O nome da cidade será Hamoná. Assim, purificarão a terra.

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֨ה בֶן־ אָדָ֜ם כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֣ר׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהֹוִ֗ה אֱמֹר֩ לְצִפּ֨וֹר כָּל־ כָּנָ֜ף וּלְכֹ֣ל׀ חַיַּ֣ת הַשָּׂדֶ֗ה הִקָּבְצ֤וּ וָבֹ֙אוּ֙ הֵאָסְפ֣וּ מִסָּבִ֔יב עַל־ זִבְחִ֗י אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲנִ֜י זֹבֵ֤חַ לָכֶם֙ זֶ֣בַח גָּד֔וֹל עַ֖ל הָרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֥ם בָּשָׂ֖ר וּשְׁתִ֥יתֶם דָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ḇen- ’ā·ḏām kōh- ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ĕ·mōr lə·ṣip·pō·wr kāl- kā·nāp̄ ū·lə·ḵōl ḥay·yaṯ haś·śā·ḏeh hiq·qā·ḇə·ṣū wā·ḇō·’ū hê·’ā·sə·p̄ū mis·sā·ḇîḇ ‘al- ziḇ·ḥî ’ă·šer ’ă·nî zō·ḇê·aḥ lā·ḵem ze·ḇaḥ gā·ḏō·wl ‘al hā·rê yiś·rā·’êl wa·’ă·ḵal·tem bā·śār ū·šə·ṯî·ṯem dām
verses.literal: And as for you son of man this is what the Lord GOD says Call out to every kind . . . of bird and to every beast of the field Assemble and come together from all around to the sacrificial feast that I am preparing for you . . . a great feast on the mountains of Israel There you will eat flesh and drink blood
verses.literalPt: Filho do homem, assim diz o Senhor Jeová: Fala às aves de toda sorte, e a todo animal do campo: Congregai-vos e vinde; ajuntai-vos de todos os lados para o meu sacrifício que sacrifico por vós, um sacrifício grande, sobre os montes de Israel, para comerdes carne e beberdes sangue.

verses.original: בְּשַׂ֤ר גִּבּוֹרִים֙ תֹּאכֵ֔לוּ וְדַם־ נְשִׂיאֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ תִּשְׁתּ֑וּ אֵילִ֨ים כָּרִ֤ים וְעַתּוּדִים֙ פָּרִ֔ים מְרִיאֵ֥י בָשָׁ֖ן כֻּלָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: bə·śar gib·bō·w·rîm tō·ḵê·lū wə·ḏam- nə·śî·’ê hā·’ā·reṣ tiš·tū ’ê·lîm kā·rîm wə·‘at·tū·ḏîm pā·rîm mə·rî·’ê ḇā·šān kul·lām
verses.literal: You will eat the flesh of the mighty and drink the blood of the princes of the earth as though they were rams lambs goats and bulls all the fattened animals of Bashan
verses.literalPt: Comereis as carnes dos poderosos e bebereis o sangue dos príncipes da terra, de carneiros, de cordeiros, de bodes e de novilhos, todos eles cevados de Basã.

verses.original: וַאֲכַלְתֶּם־ חֵ֣לֶב לְשָׂבְעָ֔ה וּשְׁתִ֥יתֶם דָּ֖ם לְשִׁכָּר֑וֹן מִזִּבְחִ֖י אֲשֶׁר־ זָבַ֥חְתִּי לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·ḵal·tem- ḥê·leḇ lə·śā·ḇə·‘āh ū·šə·ṯî·ṯem dām lə·šik·kā·rō·wn miz·ziḇ·ḥî ’ă·šer- zā·ḇaḥ·tî lā·ḵem
verses.literal: At the sacrifice I am preparing you will eat fat until you are gorged and drink blood until you are drunk
verses.literalPt: Comereis a gordura até vós fartardes e bebereis o sangue até ficardes embriagados, do meu sacrifício que sacrifiquei por vós.

verses.original: וּשְׂבַעְתֶּ֤ם עַל־ שֻׁלְחָנִי֙ ס֣וּס וָרֶ֔כֶב גִּבּ֖וֹר וְכָל־ אִ֣ישׁ מִלְחָמָ֑ה נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·śə·ḇa‘·tem ‘al- šul·ḥā·nî sūs wā·re·ḵeḇ gib·bō·wr wə·ḵāl ’îš mil·ḥā·māh nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: And at My table you will eat your fill of horses and riders of mighty men and warriors . . . of every kind declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: À minha mesa, fartar-vos-eis de cavalos e de carros, de valentes e de todos os homens de guerra, diz o Senhor Jeová.

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֥י אֶת־ כְּבוֹדִ֖י בַּגּוֹיִ֑ם וְרָא֣וּ כָל־ הַגּוֹיִ֗ם אֶת־ מִשְׁפָּטִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔יתִי וְאֶת־ יָדִ֖י אֲשֶׁר־ שַׂ֥מְתִּי בָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- kə·ḇō·w·ḏî bag·gō·w·yim wə·rā·’ū ḵāl hag·gō·w·yim ’eṯ- miš·pā·ṭî ’ă·šer ‘ā·śî·ṯî wə·’eṯ- yā·ḏî ’ă·šer- śam·tî ḇā·hem
verses.literal: I will display My glory among the nations and all the nations will see the judgment that I execute and the hand that I lay upon them
verses.literalPt: Estabelecerei a minha glória entre as nações, e todas as nações verão o meu juízo que eu tiver executado e a minha mão que eu sobre eles tiver posto.

verses.original: וְיָֽדְעוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹֽהֵיהֶ֑ם מִן־ הַיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא וָהָֽלְאָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem min- hay·yō·wm ha·hū wā·hā·lə·’āh
verses.literal: From that day forward the house of Israel will know that I am the LORD their God
verses.literalPt: Assim, saberão os da casa de Israel que eu sou Jeová, seu Deus, desde aquele dia em diante.

verses.original: וְיָדְע֣וּ הַ֠גּוֹיִם כִּ֣י בַעֲוֺנָ֞ם גָּל֣וּ בֵֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל עַ֚ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָֽעֲלוּ־ בִ֔י וָאַסְתִּ֥ר פָּנַ֖י מֵהֶ֑ם וָֽאֶתְּנֵם֙ בְּיַ֣ד צָרֵיהֶ֔ם וַיִּפְּל֥וּ בַחֶ֖רֶב כֻּלָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū hag·gō·w·yim kî ḇa·‘ă·wō·nām gā·lū ḇêṯ- yiś·rā·’êl ‘al ’ă·šer mā·‘ă·lū- ḇî wā·’as·tir pā·nay mê·hem wā·’et·tə·nêm bə·yaḏ ṣā·rê·hem way·yip·pə·lū ḇa·ḥe·reḇ kul·lām
verses.literal: And the nations will know that the house of Israel went into exile for their iniquity because they were unfaithful to Me So I hid My face from them and delivered them into the hands of their enemies so that they all fell by the sword
verses.literalPt: E saberão as nações que a casa de Israel, por causa da sua iniquidade, foi levada ao cativeiro, porque eles transgrediram contra mim, e eu escondi deles o meu rosto. Assim, os entreguei nas mãos dos seus adversários, e todos eles caíram à espada.

verses.original: כְּטֻמְאָתָ֥ם וּכְפִשְׁעֵיהֶ֖ם עָשִׂ֣יתִי אֹתָ֑ם וָאַסְתִּ֥ר פָּנַ֖י מֵהֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: kə·ṭum·’ā·ṯām ū·ḵə·p̄iš·‘ê·hem ‘ā·śî·ṯî ’ō·ṯām wā·’as·tir pā·nay mê·hem
verses.literal: I dealt with them according to their uncleanness and transgressions and I hid My face from them
verses.literalPt: Conforme a sua imundícia e conforme as suas transgressões, me houve com eles e escondi deles o meu rosto.

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה עַתָּ֗ה אָשִׁיב֙ אֶת־ שְׁבִית יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וְרִֽחַמְתִּ֖י כָּל־ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְקִנֵּאתִ֖י לְשֵׁ֥ם קָדְשִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ‘at·tāh ’ā·šîḇ ’eṯ- šə·ḇīṯ ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·ri·ḥam·tî kāl- bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl wə·qin·nê·ṯî lə·šêm qāḏ·šî
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says Now I will restore Jacob from captivity and will have compassion on the whole house of Israel and I will be jealous for My holy name
verses.literalPt: Portanto, assim diz o Senhor Jeová: Agora, tornarei a trazer o cativeiro de Jacó, e terei compaixão de toda a casa de Israel, e zelarei pelo meu santo nome.

verses.original: וְנָשׂוּ֙ אֶת־ כְּלִמָּתָ֔ם וְאֶת־ כָּל־ מַעֲלָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָעֲלוּ־ בִ֑י בְּשִׁבְתָּ֧ם עַל־ אַדְמָתָ֛ם לָבֶ֖טַח וְאֵ֥ין מַחֲרִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·śū ’eṯ- kə·lim·mā·ṯām wə·’eṯ- kāl- ma·‘ă·lām ’ă·šer mā·‘ă·lū- ḇî bə·šiḇ·tām ‘al- ’aḏ·mā·ṯām lā·ḇe·ṭaḥ wə·’ên ma·ḥă·rîḏ
verses.literal: They will forget their disgrace and all the treachery they committed against Me when they dwell securely in their land with no one to frighten them
verses.literalPt: Levarão sobre si a sua vergonha e todas as suas transgressões pelas quais transgrediram contra mim, quando habitarem seguros na sua terra, e ninguém os amedrontará,

verses.original: בְּשׁוֹבְבִ֤י אוֹתָם֙ מִן־ הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים וְקִבַּצְתִּ֣י אֹתָ֔ם מֵֽאַרְצ֖וֹת אֹֽיְבֵיהֶ֑ם וְנִקְדַּ֣שְׁתִּי בָ֔ם לְעֵינֵ֖י הַגּוֹיִ֥ם רַבִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: bə·šō·wḇ·ḇî ’ō·w·ṯām min- hā·‘am·mîm wə·qib·baṣ·tî ’ō·ṯām mê·’ar·ṣō·wṯ ’ō·yə·ḇê·hem wə·niq·daš·tî ḇām lə·‘ê·nê hag·gō·w·yim rab·bîm
verses.literal: When I bring them back from the peoples and gather them out of the lands of their enemies I will show My holiness in them in the sight of many nations
verses.literalPt: quando eu tiver tornado a trazê-los dentre os povos, e os tiver ajuntado das terras dos seus inimigos, e for santificado neles à vista de muitas nações.

verses.original: וְיָדְע֗וּ כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ם בְּהַגְלוֹתִ֤י אֹתָם֙ אֶל־ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְכִנַּסְתִּ֖ים עַל־ אַדְמָתָ֑ם וְלֹֽא־ אוֹתִ֥יר ע֛וֹד מֵהֶ֖ם שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem bə·haḡ·lō·w·ṯî ’ō·ṯām ’el- hag·gō·w·yim wə·ḵin·nas·tîm ‘al- ’aḏ·mā·ṯām wə·lō- ’ō·w·ṯîr ‘ō·wḏ mê·hem šām
verses.literal: Then they will know that I am the LORD their God when I regather them to their own land not leaving any of them . . . behind after their exile . . . among the nations
verses.literalPt: Saberão que eu sou Jeová, seu Deus, vendo que os fiz ir para o cativeiro entre as nações e tornei a ajuntá-los para a sua terra. Não deixarei lá nenhum deles doravante,

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ אַסְתִּ֥יר ע֛וֹד פָּנַ֖י מֵהֶ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר שָׁפַ֤כְתִּי אֶת־ רוּחִי֙ עַל־ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- ’as·tîr ‘ō·wḏ pā·nay mê·hem ’ă·šer šā·p̄aḵ·tî ’eṯ- rū·ḥî ‘al- bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: And I will no longer hide My face from them for I will pour out My Spirit on the house of Israel declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: nem lhes esconderei mais o meu rosto, pois derramei o meu Espírito sobre a casa de Israel, diz o Senhor Jeová.
